re_derived_post_merge: Re-measured at the FINAL head after both merges (f1c3b3aa and 99c77eb7) and after the review documentation fixes, because reach was the one merge-sensitive figure the report's own §5b standard had missed. The instrumentation is byte-identical to the pre-merge run's and the counts are UNCHANGED at 52 and 56. The pre-merge instrumented build was dee00fce7912499d against a b8ff1445 gate; the figures below are the post-merge pair.
what: C147 reach census for the G33b gate: how many times the built predicate fires inside the two swept windows. Measured with a THROWAWAY instrumented build whose only difference from the gate build is the two eprintln! lines quoted below; that build is NOT part of the patch, and its own sweep artifacts are deliberately not committed because its fingerprint is not reproducible from any committed tree.
why_a_separate_measurement: A verdict-level sweep cannot see this gate fire. At every firing site the baseline plan was ALREADY unusable, so any mutation preserving the booking count reproduces the baseline output exactly; the only detectable change at a firing site is the one that makes the count reconcile, which is the gate itself.
